units.source_text: 大家扭着身子笑了起来。

en.t: Everyone twisted their bodies and burst out laughing.

units.source_text: 嘲笑这种东西是这样的耀眼。

en.t: Mockery was something that could shine so dazzlingly.

units.source_text: 对我来说，同班同学那种少年期特有的残酷的笑声，犹如洒满阳光的叶丛那样璀璨夺目。

en.t: To me, the cruel laughter of my classmates, so characteristic of boyhood, glittered like leaves flooded with sunlight.
